# Deep Research Skill for Muse

Hand Muse a research question and it investigates against high-trust primary sources — official docs, specs, first-party APIs — rather than second-hand write-ups, following every claim back to the source that owns it and capturing the findings as a cited Markdown report. Honest note: the original text is written with a developer's workflow in mind (it talks about background agents and saving notes in a repo), but the discipline works for any researcher — point it at the primary sources of your own field and read the cited report yourself.
